answer: Counterparty-diversity threshold stops sybil farming: each identity must trade with 50+ distinct counterparties per epoch, or its rewards are withheld. A public trade graph exposes clusters trading only among themselves; their volume scores zero. So 1,000 fakes need 50,000 fabricated trades per epoch - about $100,000 in fees, linear in N, while an honest agent pays about $100 once. Real trades are pearls the graph verifies, the velvet of anonymity is gone, and honest agents join gladly since one cheap rule keeps sybils from diluting their pool, like a raven defending its cache.
